html:
SMTO-CFG-0102 — The Tool result preview sizes aren't valid

GUID: ccb31c80-3657-51e2-846b-cbea3863868c
Slug: tool-result-delivery-invalid
Domain: CFG · Subsystem: tool

What happened

  • Tool result preview sets how many characters from the start and end of each tool's output the Agent sees. Both must be whole numbers, and at least one must be above zero.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Open Settings › Agent behavior › Advanced and find Tool result preview. That's where SMTO keeps the start and end sizes for tool output.
  2. Enter whole numbers in Head characters and Tail characters, for example 6000 each. Either one can be 0, but not both. With both at zero the Agent would see none of a tool's output.
  3. If a script or another program changes SMTO settings, ask the person who set it up to use the Tool result preview sizes and stop sending the old full tool results option. That older option was removed, so SMTO refuses it.

What success looks like

  • Tool result preview saves without an error, and the next step of any task uses the new sizes.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO, along with any script or program that changes SMTO settings. Don't type text or decimals into these boxes, and don't repeat an action whose result you're unsure of; check the conversation first.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • tool_result_preview failed validation (head_characters or tail_characters not nonnegative integers, or both zero), or a write used a removed delivery key (tool_result_delivery_mode, full_tool_results or tool_result_delivery_version).

What this means

  • Tool result preview needs nonnegative integer head_characters and tail_characters with a positive combined allowance. Legacy delivery-mode writes are no longer supported. The owning policy, configuration or publication transaction validates this state. Diagnostics do not grant authority, replace accepted snapshots, execute capabilities or publish a site; preserve the exact current decision and evidence.

Why this can happen

  • Tool result preview needs nonnegative integer head_characters and tail_characters with a positive combined allowance. Legacy delivery-mode writes are no longer supported.

How to diagnose it

  • Check tool_result_preview. Legacy task modes are ignored; the current global settings apply at preparation.

How to fix it

  • Write tool_result_preview as an object with nonnegative integer head_characters and tail_characters whose sum is positive, in the agent_settings namespace (Settings › Agent behavior › Advanced › Tool result preview), and remove retired delivery keys from integration writes. Changes apply at the next model call, including existing tasks.
  • Set Head characters and Tail characters in Tool result preview. Integrations must write tool_result_preview. Changes apply at the next model call, including existing tasks.

Retry and execution caution

  • Confirm current state and correct the reported condition before requesting another attempt. Do not replay work with an unknown outcome.

How to verify the fix

  • Both character allowances are valid and the next model call uses the new values.

What not to do

  • Do not delete retained evidence or retry an operation whose effect is unknown.
